items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: Mr. Houston plays all these things... they are not satisfied with Houston... everybody want me.

ctx.x: He asked me, would I play their ball? He said, they were dissatisfied with the Neville brothers. Uh-huh. They want me. So, I said, well, you know, I played for the Autocrat Circle. I said, but, and I said, let me tell you, because this is a money thing now I'm thinking about. I said, if you call me any time, and we get together and sign a contract, and agree on the money, I said, sure I'll play. Whereas they give me time to tell the Autocrat Circle I have another engagement, but I'll only be going for one year.…
Did you hear any brass bands on a carnival day? Well yeah, well you know, what happened, you would always hear some, there'll always be some
